name: notice_body_contexts
prior_exposure: The source archive, titles, keyword counts and earlier scoped financial/primary reviews are already available. Some stored snippets have been inspected. This is a source-semantic audit, not a blinded statistical trial or 509 pages of newly claimed human reading.
methods: Rehash all selected source PDFs, metadata and receipts. Re-extract full physical pages with pypdf and PyMuPDF and compare original pypdf pages and independent numeric inventories without joining numeric whitespace. Preserve any discrepancy.

Bind every selected word occurrence to its complete period-delimited sentence, physical-page span and neighboring source text. Preserve page boundaries, headings, table labels, negations, conditional language, financial periods and securities. No keyword match or absence accepts a financial field.

Review all 333 scoped occurrences. Distinguish regulatory revisions, security-status table labels, conditional corporate changes, express negation and actual amendments. Ambiguous terms require full relevant page inspection or an explicit unresolved outcome. Grouping requires an exact supported semantic context; do not discard qualifiers.

Keep title and body roles separate from financial acceptance. A conversion suspension is not a stock suspension, a pending restart is not an observed opening, and a corporate or offering price is not recipient cash. Existing financial and event gaps stay explicit.

Preserve all original 1452 accepted records/1530 fields, all 387 residual events, the eight quarantined extra listing proposals, active runtime/data/model/account/plan identities and original source/publication-time limitations. The other received documents remain in scope for later complete relationship review. No alpha candidates, financial rules or thresholds change.
